subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Teachers check the wall every day to remove hurtful words, but most notes are kind.”?
options: Still, people remembered the small one because it had shown a quiet kind of kindness: making room for others even when it costs comfort.
It became something with a voice, even if humans had to speak for it.
The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.
People enter more easily when the door connects to something they already care about.
